t: Hay - Opinions on KMS Hayloft? - Guinea Pig Cages
s: June 8, 2014 - I bought 45lbs of KMS bluegrass, and I love it. If I wasn't allergic to timothy I'd probably buy from SPS instead, but since I have to get orchard or bluegrass, KMS is the best option for me. You might want to try a small amount to see how your pigs like it before buying a huge box of it, but if you decided to keep using KMS definitely buy the 45 pounds.
